text:
Correction for the worker: in `webhooks`, `depends_on` is currently `["profile"]`. `webhooks` must depend directly on `indexer`, so change it to `["indexer", "profile"]`, or at least include `"indexer"`.

`indexer` already comes before `webhooks` in `"order"`, so the order needs no change. Do not add any dependency that leads to `scheduler`. Leave everything else unchanged.
